evals.prompt: Use only saved ACME research and locally available filing, valuation, and portfolio evidence. assertions: The response recognizes that every common identity and setup gate passed, treats the 8-K as material-event evidence, and uses 10-Q and 10-K report_date values for periodic gap detection to find no missing quarter after 2025-09-30.

The response marks the $180 price trigger clear, both thesis-broken triggers fired, and the populated better_opportunity trigger fired because BETA has 35% base-case upside while event-adjusted ACME has negative base-case upside.
